title: Amazon's Deadly Miami Crash, United Flies Back to Tel Aviv, and a Duct-Taped Passenger Loses His Job
summary: A cargo 767 overruns the runway in Miami and it's fatal — we break down what we know so far. United beats Delta back into Tel Aviv as Middle East service slowly reopens, and the guy who got duct-taped to his American Airlines seat has now lost his job too. Plus, a preserved A340 goes out in flames and a Southwest bag drop gets someone sued.
